decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings are a core component compatible with the firm's drainage families and had their own page in both years, so they fit the established portfolio.
Floor-level shower drainage is the heart of the firm's strategic direction toward accessible, low-profile bathrooms, and the line was promoted to its own page in 2019.
The designer drain is a flagship for design-conscious architects, and although its website prominence fell in 2019, design variants are usually refreshed within the line rather than withdrawn.
Shower elements with an integrated slope support integrated, easy-install renovation solutions, though their modest visibility suggests a smaller role in the portfolio.
The DallSafe backflow basement drain was featured on the home page, and demand for flood protection is rising, so it is a strong product.
Air-admittance valves are a peripheral but low-cost complementary accessory that rounds out the drainage offering for installers, so keeping them carries little burden.
